name: Alex Carter

philosophies.name: First Principles Thinking
philosophies.description: Deconstruct problems to their fundamental truths. Challenge assumptions before optimizing, and ground solutions in core constraints.

philosophies.name: Security by Design
philosophies.description: Security is architectural, not an afterthought. Model threats early and build least-privilege principles into the foundation.

Tools should serve the problem, not dictate the solution.
leadership_style: Collaborative, transparent, and hands-on. Lead by example with high engineering standards.
